en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Target of the subject is to give the knowledge about the wood finishing determinate to the indoor and to the outdoor, about processes continuing during the wood finishing, about using the mechanization and assembly lines of the finishing and about demands for quality of finished surfaces, gaining knowledge and skills in the development of technological procedures and standards
